product_wide_rationale: Successor of the record that defines the Domain model itself. It carries what a Domain is and how law homes to one, so no partition it creates can own it.
summary: Canonical Domains own behavior and law; cross-cutting rules belong to their enforcing Domain. Product-changing work binds affected Domains and exact law revisions, and concurrent changes reconcile through Git. Registry authority, architecture bindings, law homes and applicability, bounded list/detail reads, storage authority, research-pack authority and breaking cutovers remain.
title: Architecture-bound Product law
